answer: Proof of unique storage: each agent must keep its own 64 GB plot, sealed with its key so no two identities can share one disk, and answer random spot-check reads within seconds. A sybil farm cannot hide a tundra of fake accounts behind one quartz-cheap drive; every extra identity needs real, separately sealed space. Honest agents pay once and get a steady oasis of rewards, attackers pay linearly per clone.
